question: A fast and low shot in badminton that makes a horizontal flight over the net is known as
solution:
The correct answer is__** Drive**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• A fast,** low shot in badminton that travels horizontally over the net is called a drive**.
 
• The **drive is a basic and important shot for all players to learn.**
 
• It's a powerful counter-attacking shot that can force your opponent to hit an upward return. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Drop:**

 
 
• A s**hot that barely clears the net and falls into the opponent's court**.

 
 
• Drops can be hit from anywhere on the court, but are typically hit from the back court overhead or from the front court upward or flat. 
 
 
 
 
 
• **Flick serve: ** A deceptive serve where you start the rally long. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• Some other badminton shots
 
• **Clear**:
 
 
• A long shot from the back of your court to the back of your opponent's court. 
 
 
 
• **Smash: **A strong, downward shot. 
 
• **Lift **
 
 
• **​**A high and long shot from the front of your court to the back of your opponent's court. 
 
 
 
• **Net shot: **
 
 
• **​**A short shot from the front of your court to the front of your opponent's court.
